Built Specifically for Texas Solar Operations

We eliminate the friction of scheduling, managing in-house field fleets, and navigating regional Texas utility nuances.

Full ERCOT & Texas Utility Proficiency

Our surveyors understand the exact meter socket, disconnect, and labeling requirements for Oncor, CenterPoint Energy, AEP Texas, CPS Energy, Austin Energy, and TNMP.

One-Touch CAD Deliverables

Every survey delivers standardized 36-photo packages, verified digital pitch readings, rafter spans, and single-line parameters ready for immediate AutoCAD, HelioScope, or Aurora import.

Zero Payroll Overhead & No Travel Fees

Pay on-demand per completed, QA-verified survey. Expand your sales into Dallas, Houston, Austin, San Antonio, or West Texas overnight without hiring regional staff.

Standardized Texas Survey Disciplines

Our surveyors capture every critical physical, electrical, and structural parameter required for solar engineering stamps and municipal AHJ permits.

Roof Geometry & Condition Audit

Physical verification of all roof planes, digital pitch gauge readings, shingle/tile layer counts, granular condition, and millimeter-accurate obstruction coordinates (vents, pipes, skylights).

Digital Pitch Verification Attic Rafter & Truss Spacing IFC 36" Fire Setbacks Obstruction X/Y Offsets

Electrical MSP & 120% Busbar Rule

Full interior dead-front removal to photograph manufacturer labels, busbar ampacity ratings, main breaker sizes, grounding electrode conductors, and spare breaker slots.

Busbar Nameplate Audit NEC 705.12 Calculations Utility Meter & Socket Spec Subpanel Load Verification

Battery Storage & Gateway Clearances

Specialized energy storage checks verifying NFPA 855 boundaries (3ft from doors/windows), system controller/gateway placement, and continuous conduit routing to the main electrical service.

NFPA 855 Clearances Gateway & Transfer Switch Conduit Pathway Distance Critical Loads Audit

36-Photo Georeferenced Package

High-resolution 4K photographs covering 4 exterior building elevations, street access, utility meter context, attic structural ties, and optional FAA Part 107 drone photogrammetry.

4 Building Elevations Attic Rafter Macro Shots Geotagged & Timestamped Cloud Portal Download

How Texas Survey Coordination Works

A friction-free four-stage pipeline connecting your sales intake directly to CAD drafting.

01 PROJECT INTAKE

Submit Project & Requirements

Provide the property address, prelim CAD/proposal, utility bill, and specific survey scope (roof planes, electrical panel, battery storage, attic access) via our fast intake portal.

FIELD VERIFICATIONS:
  • Address & Geo-coordinates
  • Utility Information & Notes
  • Prelim Proposal / Layout
  • Special Access Instructions
02 DISPATCH & COORDINATION

Surveyor Matched & Scheduled

Our operations dispatch team assigns a vetted local site surveyor equipped with certified safety gear, digital pitch gauges, multimeters, and drones, and confirms site access directly.

FIELD VERIFICATIONS:
  • Vetted Field Network
  • Availability Confirmation
  • Customer Access Coordination
  • Safety & PPE Compliance
03 FIELD EXECUTION

Comprehensive Field Survey

The surveyor performs an exhaustive on-site audit: 36-photo standard, MSP dead-front busbar verification, rafter dimensions, pitch measurements, obstruction coordinates, and battery clearances.

FIELD VERIFICATIONS:
  • 36-Photo Geotagged Set
  • MSP Dead-Front Inspection
  • Rafter & Truss Measurement
  • Obstruction Offsets (X/Y)
04 QA & DELIVERY

CAD-Ready Package Delivered

Every photo, measurement, and electrical reading undergoes internal triple-check QA before release. Your engineering and drafting team receives an organized, CAD-ready package.

FIELD VERIFICATIONS:
  • One-Touch CAD Formatting
  • Single-Line Diagram Ready
  • Defect-Free Guarantee
  • Encrypted Cloud Delivery
